title: Coin Card Manifest
description: Signed registry record for an ImplicitEx Coin Card. Defines the canonical recipient, accepted asset, network, and ownership claim for a verified payment identity.

cardId.description: Unique card identifier. Letters, digits, underscores, hyphens. 3–80 chars. Used as the URL path segment and registry file key.

status.description: 'active' = valid for transfer. 'revoked' = card invalid; the card surface must refuse transfer and hide the recipient.

owner.description: Authority over this Coin Card. Who controls the payment identity. Distinct from recipient (where funds settle) and displayName (human label).

name.description: Human-readable name of the issuing authority.

domain.description: Domain of the issuing authority. Used for trust display.

displayName.description: Public-facing label shown to senders. May differ from owner.name.

displayCredential.description: Short credential string shown on the card face (e.g. 'CC IMPLICITEX DEMO AB3919').

recipient.description: Canonical EVM wallet address that receives USDC. The card never becomes a payment surface until this field is verified from the registry.

chainId.description: EVM chain ID (e.g. 137 = Polygon Mainnet). chainId is authoritative; chainName is informational.

amountMode.description: 'user-input': sender specifies the amount. 'locked': amount is fixed by the card issuer and cannot be changed.

lockedAmount.description: Fixed transfer amount in token units (e.g. 25.00 = 25 USDC). Required when amountMode is 'locked'.

sourceDomain.description: Domain where this card is intended to be embedded. Informational in V1.

updatedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of last manifest update.

revokedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of revocation. Null if not revoked.

signature.description: Cryptographic signature over the manifest. Not required for V1 static registry. Required for distributed or user-issued cards.

value.description: Base64-encoded signature over the canonical manifest JSON.

signedAt.description: Timestamp when the signature was created.

signerDomain.description: Domain of the signing authority. Must match owner.domain for V1.
